message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through old boxes in the attic and stumbled upon a deck of cards. It reminded me of those rainy afternoons spent with the grandkids, playing games and laughing together, with no screens in sight. 🃏 We had so much fun, and it made me think about how simple joys can be just as important as our emergency plans. Sometimes, a little low-tech fun can remind us of what really matters and help us bond as a family. What’s your favorite way to connect without technology?
